scope: Additive finite publication exporter; no upload, Git mutation or author-bundle writes.

fixture_tests.data: Invented exporter fixture only; no network or clinical session execution.
fixture_tests.prior_attempt: 19 passed and one fixture failed on Windows path-length limit in the longer basetemp path; shorter basetemp completed all 20 tests.

base_scope: Local mirror clean/head verified; parent reports remote connector confirmed the same head. Exporter itself makes no remote request; later upload must recheck it.
implemented_checks: Exact finite paths, all required final files, no candidates
Author closure, locked design, private inventory hashes, complete candidate/seed schedule
Safe public metadata projections; omit local protocol bundle path and private closure inventory
Forbidden suffixes/paths, JSON row and source-body keys, secret-shaped values, file-size/type limits
Known selected/existing-public links only; private gateway-state link visibly labels the public summary projection
Local/public SHA256 plus Git blob SHA; immutable originals preserved except documented Markdown/metadata projections
Maximum 32000-character base64 chunks with round-trip hash verification
additional_original_code_review: plot_results.py consumes aggregate stage estimates and displays all five prespecified reference-bearing endpoints; it does not read individual tables.
summarize_actions.py extracts bounded action metadata and acquisition cost summaries, not response/source bodies or individual rows. Its final bytes still undergo export scanning.

compare_previous.py requires both authors closed, verifies evaluation-to-closure hashes, records both input hash pairs, retains all five reference-bearing endpoints and explicitly disclaims causal attribution.
edge_cases: No directory copy or implicit optional results; missing final outputs refuse.
Unknown private links refuse; only two exact historical candidate links map to existing public files. No new candidate bytes are selected.
The old gateway-state hyperlink maps to an existing public ACTION_SUMMARY with visible projection wording and QA metadata.
Locked source/code files are not rewritten; original design hashes remain local commitments and may differ from documented public projections.
limits: This review does not approve scientific conclusions, source validity or author quality.
Signature/key screening cannot prove arbitrary content is free of every secret, individual record or copied passage; root must inspect final files and aggregate figures.
No production transport prepared by this reviewer. Root should execute the exporter after complete closure/results review.

schema_fix.reason: Production preflight initially rejected aggregate independent arithmetic-check records as a possible individual-record collection.
constraints: Nonempty method; integer count equal to 1..30 records
Run IDs are bounded safe identifiers; run/endpoint pairs unique
Only the five prespecified reference-bearing endpoint IDs
Reported/recomputed/difference values finite numeric values, excluding booleans
Differences nonnegative; maximum field equals observed maximum
schema_fix.tests: Exact document/path accepted; another document/path, patient rows at the same path, extra patient fields, booleans, unknown endpoints, duplicate pairs and wrong counts rejected.
schema_fix.generic_records_policy: Unchanged; no general numeric-record or patient-row allowance.
